turns.utterance: completed all three checks protective window and lens clear, beam path enclosure intact and mountng ring secure

turns.utterance: Is the lens or beam path window scratched, chipped, or contaminated?

turns.utterance: no both lens and window clean and undamaged

turns.utterance: Is the laser head temperature within the rated operating range?

turns.utterance: yeah temp readings well within rated range

ground_truth.node_text: Laser head temperature within rated operating range?

turns.utterance: Is the beam centred within zero point one millimetre of field centre?

turns.utterance: yes burn mark centred within tolerance

ground_truth.node_text: Beam centred within 0.1 mm of field centre?

turns.utterance: Is the output power within plus or minus five percent of the rated value at one hundred percent duty cycle?

turns.utterance: no measured power about 7% below spec

ground_truth.node_text: Output power within ±5% of rated value at 100% duty cycle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Navigate to the laser power calibration menu in the marking software, place the calibrated power meter at the focal plane, and follow the on-screen sequence. Record the measured output power and confirm it meets the specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Navigate to the laser power calibration menu in the marking software. 2. Place the calibrated power meter at the focal plane and follow the on-screen sequence. 3. Record the measured output power and confirm it meets the specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ok so calibration routine completed power meter reading within spec now

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Navigate to the laser power calibration menu in the marking software. 2. Place the calibrated power meter at the focal plane and follow the on-screen sequence. 3. Record the measured output power and confirm it meets the specification.

turns.utterance: Reverify output power after calibration routine.

turns.utterance: confirmed output power now within acceptable range

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify output power after calibration routine

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the pulse frequency stable at all programmed values?

ground_truth.node_text: Pulse frequency stable at all programmed values?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah frequency measurments stable and within tolerance across all programed values

ground_truth.node_text: Pulse frequency stable at all programmed values?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the focal point at the correct working distance, plus or minus zero point two millimetres?

ground_truth.node_text: Focal point at correct working distance ±0.2 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no best focus about 0.4mm off from stored parameter

ground_truth.node_text: Focal point at correct working distance ±0.2 mm?

turns.utterance: Adjust the z axis focus offset in the marking controller.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: focus offset adjusted and saved to controller

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust z axis focus offset in marking controller

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity and calculate volumetric flow rate, then compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity in metres per second and calculate volumetric flow rate from the duct cross sectional area. Compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class in the safety datasheet.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The anemometer is giving me really erratic readings that jump around by 50% every second - I think the probe's thermal sensor might be damaged or there's something wrong with the calibration module itself.

turns.utterance: measurements taken and flow rate calculated recorded values for comparision

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class in the safety datasheet.

turns.utterance: Is the extraction flow rate above the minimum required value?

turns.utterance: no flow rate below min spec

ground_truth.node_text: Extraction flow rate above minimum required value?

turns.utterance: Replace the extraction filter cartridge and recheck the flow.

turns.utterance: filter cartridge replaced and flow recheked

ground_truth.node_text: Replace extraction filter cartridge and recheck flow

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port.

ground_truth.node_text: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port. Do not touch mirror surfaces; if spatter deposits are found that cannot be cleared by air, log the condition and schedule mirror replacement at the next planned maintenance window.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: scan head cover removed mirrors inspected and cleaned with compressed air

ground_truth.node_text: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port. Do not touch mirror surfaces; if spatter deposits are found that cannot be cleared by air, log the condition and schedule mirror replacement at the next planned maintenance window.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

ground_truth.node_text: Galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: Hey, do you know if we need to submit a separate work order for the cooling system maintenance, or does that fall under this PM cycle?

ground_truth.node_text: Galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: The marks look okay on width and depth, but I'm seeing some micro-cracking around the edges of the characters that isn't mentioned in the quality standard—should I be concerned about that?

turns.utterance: test marks completed and inspected all parameters look good logged results with substrate lot number

ground_truth.node_text: All 9 calibration grid points within ±0.05 mm of nominal?
